observed_approach: <the technique the student appears to be using, or unknown>
stated_reasoning: <what the student said about their reasoning, or unknown>

prerequisite_status.concept: <prerequisite concept id (matches a Question Schema prerequisite_concepts[].concept_id)>
prerequisite_status.status: <one of: unknown | partially demonstrated | confirmed (assisted) | confirmed | contradicted>
prerequisite_status.evidence: <what the student did that supports this status>

components_correct: <a sub-step or component the student has gotten right>

suspected_misconception.confidence: <one of: tentative | likely | high, or none>

interventions_attempted: <a pedagogical action already taken this session, e.g. hint (T9)>
gap_notes: <free-text notes on what is still open (off-target context, never scored against the target)>
